submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE independently hand-drawn native square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite of this exact celestial musician girl. Single pose, one character, no sheet. Image1=identity and immutable hand ownership, Image2=direction and camera reference, Image3=approved clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style; any Image4 is same-direction scale/continuity anchor. Keep purple high bun long hair, gold lotus/pearl crown, violet eyes, ivory-lavender-gold embroidered long sleeves, short tunic over puffy lavender trousers, ivory-purple boots, green waist knot, ONE rigid elongated flat purple-gold qin. Anatomical LEFT supports upper qin, anatomical RIGHT rests/grips lower string face, both hands continuously attached during run. Both shoulders and elbows rotate naturally with stride while retaining grips, no hand swap. Two arms and two legs only, coherent hips/knees/ankles and boot toes; do not hide all feet under skirt. Preserve actual alpha, translucent ribbons. Full silhouette within clear margins. Same global head/body size and camera, no zoom, no individual bbox fit or grounded recentering. Virtual canvas 1024 root(512,942), floor92%canvas. Head crown around13%canvas in contact phase and boots near92%, with small true run bob. STRICT NORTHEAST: rear three-quarter view running diagonally AWAY toward upper-right. Face only a small right-edge profile, long back hair dominant. Anatomical RIGHT side is nearer; LEFT is farther. Upper qin stays toward screen-left ahead of far left shoulder, lower qin in front of near right hand on screen-right, naturally occluded by torso; do not expose full instrument through back. FRAME NE03 of16, cycle cadence to review at640/720/800ms: RIGHT MIDSTANCE AND LEFT PASSING. Critical planted-foot correction: near RIGHT leg at SCREEN RIGHT bears weight with knee bent over ankle; RIGHT boot must be seen in THREE-QUARTER SIDE/TOP view, its outsole horizontal and weight-bearing, toe points upper-right and heel to lower-left. NO large right sole aimed at viewer; only thin purple outsole EDGE, white boot upper visible. Right foot at(62%,92%). Far LEFT knee passes FORWARD behind near right knee, left boot tiny foreshortened sliver tucked beside right calf around(55%,84%); NO large backward-facing left sole. Pelvis over right ankle, body slightly compressed; clear narrow passing phase. Same head/body size, shoulders and qin counterrotate naturally without hand swap. Hair, sleeves and ribbons lag naturally and change with gait. No background, ground, shadow, text, border, particles, glow, motion lines, trails, extra props. Highest visual finish; project target2.5Sunburst/max is host-managed, not a submitted model parameter.
